summary: Iteration 4 testing complete. Added 14 new pytest cases in test_iteration4.py covering: (a) monthly-wa-recap cron security (no auth 401, wrong bearer 401, correct bearer 200 with status=accepted + prev-month YYYY-MM); (b) Backup ZIP download full flow (run-now -> list -> download 200 application/zip non-empty, invalid stamp 404, non-admin guru 403, no-auth 401/403); (c) /api/wa-log admin (returns masked target with '*', context, status in ok|skipped|failed, reason, at; Fonnte unset -> skipped w/ reason 'whatsapp_not_configured', never 500/failed); (d) /api/wa-log RBAC (guru 403, siswa 403, no-auth 401/403); (e) light regression on admin/guru/siswa login. Full backend suite: 92/92 passed (78 existing + 14 new). Frontend smoke on /pengaturan confirmed: download-backup-0, wa-log-0, run-backup-btn, wa-test-btn all present and rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_cron.download_backup builds ZIP into tempfile per request but never cleans up; a busy admin panel could accumulate zip files in /tmp. Consider StreamingResponse or background cleanup after send.

routes_cron.download_backup sanitizes 'stamp' via isdigit/dash filter but folder is derived directly - safe from traversal but a stamp of only '-' would resolve to '/app/backups/backup-'; guard against empty/degenerate safe values with a strict regex like ^\d{8}-\d{6}$.
whatsapp._log swallows all exceptions silently (bare except: pass). Any Mongo failure means silent data loss for the audit log; at minimum log.exception.
GET /api/wa-log has no pagination/limit query params and returns up to 100 records. For long-running production it will become blind past 100; add ?limit + since/until filters.

routes_whatsapp.cron_monthly_recap uses wib_now().replace(day=1) - timedelta(days=1) which is correct, but if the cron fires just after midnight WIB on the 1st the prev month is fine; consider explicit tz-aware handling and log the target month for auditability.
